name: Jens Christensen
bio:
Jens Christensen's journey in motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate designs of Formula 1 cars as a child. He pursued a degree in materials engineering, specializing in composite materials, and quickly found his niche in the motorsport industry. Jens has worked with several racing teams, contributing to the development and maintenance of high-performance composite components. 

His approach to composite technology is meticulous and focused on reliability. Jens believes in a proactive approach, anticipating potential issues before they arise. He prides himself on his ability to adapt to changing circumstances and deliver high-quality work under pressure. What sets Jens apart is his deep understanding of material properties and his dedication to continuous improvement, always seeking ways to enhance performance and durability.

physical.description: A stocky man with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classic rock while working.
